classification: OWNER_APPROVED_ADAPTATION: a tamer level 1..50 with its own EXP and a four-line talent tree whose points are worked out from the level, the title rank and the Dex (LINE_FUSION_TAMER_TALENTS_DESIGN_20261117); a talent is a modifier read where the game works a value out and never writes a native individual, a save word or a battle code

saveField.path: progression.tamerTalents = { version: 1, level, exp, nodes: { [nodeId]: rank }, keystones: { [line]: keystoneId }, respecs }
saveField.migration: none: a save without it is Lv.1 with nothing spent; an unknown shape starts again; ranks are clamped to the node and a keystone of another line is dropped (productTamerTalents.normalizeTamerTalents)

rules.points: points = (level - 1) + 2 x title rank + floor(registered species / 25), never stored; the whole tree costs 124; the friends playtest opens all 124
rules.level: EXP to the next level = round(40 x level^1.3); Lv.50 is the cap
rules.exp: a catch brought Home 20 x grade (S 1.6, A 1.25, B 1.0, C 0.8), a fusion 8 a fodder, a settled owned-party battle TITLE/CHAMPIONSHIP 60, FREE/ARENA 30, PRACTICE 5 (a loss 40 %); paid in the same save as what earned it; password, link and online battles pay none
rules.tree: four lines x three tiers x three nodes (a rank one point; tiers open at 6 and 14 points spent in the line's nodes) and two keystones a line of which one is taken (4 points at 22)
rules.respec: every point back, keystones included; the first is free, then 500 crystals
rules.titleCap: title matches and championships count only the first 6 + 3 x rank commander points: tier one, two, three, each node rank by rank across the tier, the keystone last
rules.open: a node is offered only once its effect is wired (TALENT_WIRED_KEYS); the rest show as not open and take no point
